requirement: BOTH E1 and E5 present and PASSED; ram_measured boolean true; ram_peak_bytes positive finite numeric (Int/UInt/Double); unavailable RAM object never counts; GPU-capable requires measured numeric VRAM; CPU-only requires a non-empty VRAM unavailability reason and null value; unknown hardware capability FAILS (fail closed); malformed types rejected safely

capability_classification.GPU: explicit cuda_available=true OR authoritative GPU field (non-empty gpu_model / cuda_version, or positive vram_total_bytes)
capability_classification.Unknown: cuda_available missing/malformed and no authoritative GPU field -> FAILS; absence of evidence is not evidence of CPU-only

cases_covered: ram_measured=true with unavailable RAM object -> fail
cuda_available missing (empty hardware) on E1 -> fail
cuda_available missing (empty hardware) on E5 -> fail
unknown cuda_available but authoritative gpu_model + measured VRAM -> pass
unknown cuda_available but authoritative gpu_model and vram_measured=false -> fail
explicit cuda_available=false with valid unavailable-VRAM reason -> pass
empty / non-string / missing / non-null CPU-only VRAM reason -> fail
